technology_name: BIO-ADHESIVE ARTIFICIAL MEMBRANE GRAFT FOR TYMPANIC MEMBRANE PERFORATION THERAPY
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Resolving persistent structural eardrum tympanic membrane ruptures safely requires invasive, highly expensive grafting surgeries using patient autograft tissues under localized operating rooms.
description: An advanced biopolymer otologic membrane graft material comprising a multi-layered bio-adhesive template manufactured via micro-scale electrospinning and specialized freeze-drying loops to optimize mechanical elasticity parameters.
applications: Outpatient otolaryngology clinic packages, tympanoplasty surgical alternatives, acoustic tissue trauma repair assemblies, and bio-absorbable internal tissue matrices.
